```{python}
#| label: fig-doping-process
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Selective doping using a hard mask: (a) the wafer is covered by a hard mask (e.g., SiO$_2$), (b) the hard mask is opened by photolithography and etching, (c) dopants are introduced through the opening (shown here by implantation), and (d) after annealing, the dopants have diffused into the silicon and the crystal damage is repaired."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Ellipse
from pyutil import process as pr

MID = pr.XMAX / 2
OPEN = [(MID - 2.0, MID + 2.0)]

fig, axs = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(6.5, 7.2))

# (a) hard mask everywhere
ax = axs[0]
pr.wafer(ax)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=None)
pr.setup(ax, '(a) grow/deposit hard mask', ymax=5.6)

# (b) patterned hard mask
ax = axs[1]
pr.wafer(ax)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=OPEN)
pr.setup(ax, '(b) open hard mask by lithography and etching', ymax=5.6)

# (c) implant
ax = axs[2]
pr.wafer(ax)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=OPEN)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((MID - 2.0, pr.SURF - 0.35), 4.0, 0.35, fc='#d1862c',
                       ec='k', lw=0.5))
pr.implant_arrows(ax, y0=5.4, y1=4.6, label='dopants')
pr.setup(ax, '(c) introduce dopants', ymax=6.4)

# (d) anneal / drive-in
ax = axs[3]
pr.wafer(ax)
doped = Ellipse((MID, pr.SURF), 5.4, 2.4, fc='#d1862c', ec='k', lw=0.5)
ax.add_patch(doped)
clip = Rectangle((0, 0), pr.XMAX, pr.SURF, transform=ax.transData)
doped.set_clip_path(clip)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=OPEN)
pr.setup(ax, '(d) anneal (dopants diffuse into the Si)', ymax=5.6)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
